# Open debts

**Generated by `just roadmap-debts`. Do not edit by hand — your edit will be overwritten,
and `just roadmap-debts --check` fails when this file and its sources disagree.**

Everything this engine has not finished, from three sources of decreasing strength. It is
a view over records that are already maintained for their own reasons rather than a fourth
place to keep up to date, because a hand-written list of unfinished work goes stale exactly
when it matters most — at the moment a milestone closes and somebody adds to it.

Closed milestones: M0, M1, M2, M3, M4, M5, M5.5, M6, M7, M8.a, M8.b, M8.c, M9, M10.

## 1. Declared gaps

A criterion that **runs, fails, and names the rung that must close it**. The strongest form,
because the ledger enforces both halves: an open gap keeps failing, and a gap that starts
*passing* fails the ledger with "THE GAP IS CLOSED, DELETE THE DECLARATION" — so it cannot
rot into something quietly fixed that nobody noticed.

The mechanism arrived at M8.c. Anything earlier is in section 3, unchecked.

## 3. What each milestone said it did not close

Written prose in each archived change, and **nothing checks it**. This is the only record of
unfinished work before M8.c, because the declared-gap mechanism did not exist yet. Follow the
link for the detail rather than trusting the summary.

- **[2026-09-07-implement-m6-scale](../../openspec/changes/archive/2026-09-07-implement-m6-scale/tasks.md)** — Seven tasks above are deliberately unchecked. Each was reported by the agent that owned it or by the gate, with a reason, rather than being quietly ticked:
- **[2026-09-08-implement-m7-fidelity](../../openspec/changes/archive/2026-09-08-implement-m7-fidelity/tasks.md)** — Nineteen tasks above are unchecked. Each was reported by the agent that owned it or by the closing gate, with a reason, and the ledger's own notes carry the same list so a reader who never opens this file still finds them.
- **[2026-09-09-implement-m8a-authorable](../../openspec/changes/archive/2026-09-09-implement-m8a-authorable/tasks.md)** — Five tasks are unchecked. The milestone's own nineteen criteria are green and its artefact runs end to end; these are the edges the gate would not let pass as done.
- **[2026-09-11-implement-m8b-systems](../../openspec/changes/archive/2026-09-11-implement-m8b-systems/tasks.md)** — Thirteen tasks are unchecked. The ledger passes — 217 criteria, exit zero — and the slice plays.
- **[2026-09-11-implement-m8c-spectacle](../../openspec/changes/archive/2026-09-11-implement-m8c-spectacle/tasks.md)** — Thirteen tasks are unchecked. The ledger passes — 247 of 249 evaluated criteria — and the frame is captured rather than drawn, which is what this milestone was for.
- **[2026-09-11-implement-m9-integrity](../../openspec/changes/archive/2026-09-11-implement-m9-integrity/tasks.md)** — Sixteen tasks are unchecked. The ledger passes — 284 of 291 evaluated criteria, seven declared gaps — and the milestone's own artefact holds. These are the edges the gate would not let pass as done.
